name: Liu Zheng
bio: Liu Zheng (刘峥) has danced tango since 2006 and is one of China's first-generation tango organizers. In 2007 he founded VTango (探戈会) in Beijing, running classes, milongas and workshops with visiting teachers. In 2013 he co-founded the China Argentine Tango Association with Xu Xuanyi and launched the China qualifier of the Tango World Championship. He created Tango Holiday (2014), the Beijing Tango Open (2017) and the Beijing Tuye Tango Festival (2019). Also a long-time tango DJ, he builds on Golden Age tradition with balanced, dancer-focused energy. In 2018 he was honored by the Embassy of Argentina in China.
bio_zh: 刘峥，2006 年开始跳探戈，中国第一代探戈人。2007 年创办「探戈会（VTango）」，长期在北京组织探戈课程、舞会与外教 Workshop。2013 年与许暄宜共同成立「中国阿根廷探戈协会」，发起世界探戈锦标赛中国区赛。先后创办 Tango Holiday（2014）、北京探戈公开赛（2017）和北京兔爷探戈节（2019）。他也是资深探戈 DJ，以黄金年代传统为本，均衡分配舞会能量。2018 年获阿根廷驻华大使馆表彰。
sources: Organizer profile supplied for this preview. Also a DJ. Photo: DJ at ChunCheon Tango Festival 2025, credit ©Aiden in the image. City Beijing / 北京. Affiliation 探戈会 VTango / VTango.

name: Kai
bio: Kai Wang (王凯) was born in Taiwan, graduated from National Taipei University and studied in the US. He discovered salsa in 2005 and later fell in love with tango in Shanghai. In 2017 he founded Te Amo Tango Lounge, called "China's first tango bar" and a filming location for B for Busy (爱情神话); it moved to 583 Yuyao Road, Jing'an, in 2023. He runs Kai's Milonga every Wednesday and Sunday, and its 900th edition was held at the Paramount Ballroom on 1 Jan 2026.
bio_zh: 王凯（Kai），台湾出生，毕业于台北大学，曾赴美国留学。2005 年接触 Salsa，后在上海爱上探戈。2017 年创办 Te Amo Tango Lounge（舞爱探戈），被称为「中国第一家探戈酒吧」，也是电影《爱情神话》的取景地，2023 年迁到静安区余姚路 583 号。他长期主办 Kai's Milonga（每周三、周日），2026 年元旦在百乐门举办了第 900 场。
sources: Radar sheet 中文组织者: 王凯. English name: Kai. Photo and bios supplied for this profile. City Shanghai / 上海. Affiliation Te Amo Tango Lounge.
